content.text:
At 5, a "camping out" approach works well: start by sitting next to Milo's bed until he falls asleep, then move your chair a bit further toward the door every few nights until you're out of the room. A consistent pre-bed routine -- bath, book, lights out -- makes each step easier for him to accept.

Want the full night-by-night plan for moving Milo to his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
